outcome: need for further procedures (e.g., RPOC evacuation, hysterectomy)
cohort: The study included 31 consecutive women diagnosed with retained products of conception (RPOC) with marked vascularity, presenting with postpartum/postabortal bleeding.
finding: Uterine artery embolization was found to be an effective and safe first-line treatment for retained products of conception with marked vascularity, achieving primary clinical success in 74.2% of women.
